core.headline: Ex-local-authority mid-terrace house, Lordswood, Chatham
core.listing:
An ex-local-authority mid-terrace house with three bedrooms in Fernhill Close, Lordswood, Chatham. Guide Price £285,000. Freehold. No onward chain.

The ground floor has a lounge 4.62m x 3.48m (15'2" x 11'5"). The kitchen/diner measures 5.45m x 2.90m (17'11" x 9'6"). A lean-to utility is accessed from the kitchen. The first floor has bedroom one 3.80m x 3.10m (12'6" x 10'2"), bedroom two 3.30m x 2.95m (10'10" x 9'8") and bedroom three 2.40m x 2.05m (7'10" x 6'9"). The bathroom has a shower over the bath.

The rear garden measures approx. 9m (30ft). There is a gate to the shared rear path. On-street parking is available and no permit is required.

Fernhill Close is in Lordswood, Chatham, Kent ME5.

Guide Price £285,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band B (Medway Council). EPC rating C. Construction: Standard – Brick under a concrete tiled roof. There is a pedestrian right of way along the shared rear path. Damp mark on bathroom ceiling from a cracked roof tile, repaired August 2026, not yet redecorated. Seller unaware of planning or building regulations approval for the lean-to utility.
core.summary: Freehold ex-local-authority mid-terrace house in Fernhill Close, Lordswood, with no onward chain. Gas central heating with Worcester boiler fitted in 2019. Rear garden with gate to shared path.
